tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Render a data chart in the operator pane. Call this when the operator asks for a chart, graph, plot, or data visualization. The pane renders the chart client-side from your arguments; do not also describe the chart in prose.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Preview a file already written on local disk in the operator pane. Call after creating an HTML, SVG, image, audio, or video file. Pass only its absolute local path and type; never put file content in tool arguments. The pane fetches the file through its session-scoped /api/media endpoint and renders it safely.

type.description: Content type for rendering. html: sandboxed iframe. svg: inline SVG. image: rendered as . audio/video: media player.

path.description: Absolute path to the file on disk, e.g. /tmp/concept-login.html. The file is served to the frontend via /api/media with session-scoped access.

title.description: Optional title shown in the preview header. Default: the filename.
